settings.title: Processing time.
settings.body: Every order is packed by hand. We aim to get your box out the door within one business day of purchase. Orders placed before 2pm ET on a business day usually ship the same day.
settings.list:
Orders placed Mon–Sat before 2pm ET — ship same day
Orders placed after 2pm ET or on Sunday — ship next business day
During major launches (new gift set drops, BFCM) — processing can take up to 3 business days
You'll get a Shopify shipping confirmation email with a tracking link the moment your label prints

settings.title: Rates & delivery times.
settings.body: We ship with USPS and UPS. Shipping cost is calculated at checkout based on your ZIP and box weight, but here are the flat options for reference:
settings.rows:
Standard — USPS Ground | 3–5 business days | $5.99
Free standard — Orders $50+ | 3–5 business days | Free | highlight
Expedited — USPS Priority | 2–3 business days | $12.99
Express — UPS Next Day | 1 business day | $28.99
Local pickup — Akron, OH | By appointment | Free
settings.warn: Note: Delivery estimates start when the carrier scans your package, not when you place the order. Add processing time (usually 1 business day) to the estimates above.

settings.title: International shipping.
settings.body: Right now we ship to the United States, Canada, and the UK. More countries coming — DM us and let us know where you want us to ship next.
settings.list:
Canada: $14.99 flat, 6–10 business days
UK: $22.99 flat, 8–14 business days
Customer is responsible for any customs duties and import taxes assessed by the destination country
International orders are final sale unless item arrives damaged or defective

settings.title: Tracking your order.
settings.body:
The moment your label prints, Shopify sends you an email with a live tracking link. You'll also get SMS updates if you opted in at checkout. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show movement after the label is generated — that's normal.

If your tracking hasn't updated in more than 5 business days, it's likely stuck in transit. Email us your order number and we'll open a carrier trace on your behalf.

settings.title: Returns policy.
settings.body: We want you to love what you bought. If something isn't right, you have 30 days from delivery to return unopened, unused items for a full refund.
settings.steps:
Email us | Send a note to sunsarae37@gmail.com with your order # and what you want to return.
Get approval | We'll reply within 24hr with a return label or a pre-paid QR code (at your cost).
Ship it back | Pack items in original packaging. Drop at any USPS within 14 days of approval.
Get refunded | Refund issued to original payment within 5 business days of us receiving the return.
settings.list:
Opened lip gloss (for hygiene reasons)
Pierced earrings
Custom or personalised bracelets
Worn apparel
Items marked "Final Sale" on the product page
Items returned after the 30-day window
Items without original packaging or tags
settings.warn: Damaged or defective? That's on us — not you. Email within 7 days of delivery with photos and we'll send a replacement or full refund (including shipping), no return required.

settings.title: Exchanges.
settings.body:
We don't do traditional swaps because inventory moves fast. The smoothest path: return the original for a full refund, then place a new order for the item you want. We'll prioritize shipping it.

Wrong size, wrong shade, wrong color? Just reach out — we'll work something out.

settings.title: Frequently asked questions.
settings.qa_list:
My package says "delivered" but I don't have it. What now? || Check with neighbors and your mail room first — USPS sometimes scans early. If nothing turns up within 48 hours, email us with your order number and we'll open a carrier claim. We cover lost packages on orders with tracked shipping.
Can I change or cancel my order after placing it? || Yes, if it hasn't shipped yet. DM us on Instagram or email right away with your order number. Once a label is printed we can't recall it — you'll need to return it after delivery.
Do you ship to PO boxes or APO/FPO addresses? || Yes to both. USPS handles PO boxes and military addresses just fine. Delivery to APO/FPO can take 2–4 weeks depending on base.
What's your return address? || Returns only ship to the address we provide after you email for approval. Don't send anything to our ship-from address without talking to us first — we can't process unapproved returns.
Can I get a refund on shipping? || Original shipping is non-refundable unless the return is due to our mistake (wrong item, damaged, defective). Return shipping is at the customer's cost.
Do you do wholesale pricing? || For boutiques and retailers, yes. Email us with your business name and resale certificate and we'll send our wholesale rate sheet.
How do I use a discount code? || Enter the code at the first step of checkout (right below your email). One code per order. Newsletter signup gets you 15% off automatically.
